title: Web Document History and HTML Evolution
learningObjectives: Explain HTML's role in your own words
Distinguish the roles of HTML, CSS and JavaScript

understand.concept: HTML emerged with the early World Wide Web as a way to structure linked documents. It evolved through multiple specifications and browser implementations. Modern HTML is maintained as a living standard; avoid treating old version labels as separate languages learners must memorize. Historical dates and claims should be checked against primary standards sources before publication.
understand.whyItMatters: Understanding HTML helps you choose elements that make pages meaningful, maintainable and easier for different users and tools to interpret.
understand.history: HTML grew from the early linked-document web. Verify exact historical milestones against authoritative standards sources before publishing dates.
understand.analogy: HTML is like a plan that organizes the roles of parts in a document.
understand.analogyLimit: HTML is not a visual design tool; CSS controls visual presentation.

explain.narrative: HTML emerged with the early World Wide Web as a way to structure linked documents. It evolved through multiple specifications and browser implementations. examples.code: ఈ ఉదాహరణ ఆధునిక HTMLలో అర్థవంతమైన main నిర్మాణాన్ని చూపిస్తుంది. చరిత్రను అర్థం చేసుకోవడానికి కోడ్ కంటే ప్రమాణాల పరిణామం ముఖ్యం.
examples.explanation: ప్రారంభ World Wide Webలో లింక్‌లతో కూడిన పత్రాలకు నిర్మాణం ఇవ్వడానికి HTML అభివృద్ధి చెందింది. కాలక్రమేణా అనేక Specifications, Browser Implementations ద్వారా మారింది. ఆధునిక HTML నిరంతరం అభివృద్ధి చెందే Standard. పాత Version పేర్లను వేర్వేరు భాషలుగా కంఠస్థం చేయాల్సిన అవసరం లేదు. చారిత్రక తేదీలు, వివరాలను ప్రచురించే ముందు ప్రాథమిక ప్రమాణాల ఆధారాలతో ధృవీకరించాలి.
examples.expectedOutput: The browser displays the meaningful HTML content.

practise.guidedTask: Identify each element and attribute in the example and explain its role.
practise.independentTask: Write your own small HTML fragment using the same concept and open it in a browser.
hints: Separate HTML structure, CSS presentation and JavaScript behaviour.
A visible page alone does not guarantee valid markup.

questions.prompt: What is HTML primarily responsible for?
questions.explanation: HTML describes document structure and meaning.

questions.prompt: How does a browser use HTML?
options: Parses document structure and builds a DOM
Always treats it only as an image
questions.answer: Parses document structure and builds a DOM
questions.explanation: The DOM represents document nodes and their relationships.
